about: Crawl is the dungeon crawler where you control the monsters! Possess cruel traps and horrid beasts in an effort to slay the hero. Succeed to take their place and it's your turn to Crawl! Bring some friends to add local-multiplayer mayhem to the mix as you race to gain enough XP and loot to face them all, as they possess the limbs of the hulking final boss!
A NEW SPIN ON DUNGEON CRAWLING:
- Every trap and monster can be controlled by your real-life buddies!
- Vicious single player AI, challenges to master, and items to unlock.
- Level up, increase your stats, amass powerful weapons and magic items, all in the course of one 30 minute game.
- Evolve your monsters from spiders and rats to powerful demons, dragons and undead warriors.
- Explore and inhabit randomly generated dungeons.
- Huge variety of weapons, spells and items.
